evidence.create_database_error: {neo4j_code: Neo.ClientError.Statement.UnsupportedAdministrationCommand} {message: Unsupported administration command: CREATE DATABASE tenant_probe} {gql_status

notes: Shared database + group_id property is the only option on Neo4j Community (CREATE DATABASE is unsupported; the driver's clone() is a no-op so group_id never selects a database). Isolation holds ONLY if every call passes group_ids: search() with group_ids=None, get_by_uuid and group_id=None (-> '') are NOT scoped. ADR-015: the graph adapter (packages/graph) must derive group_id from the authenticated workspace, refuse None/empty, always pass group_ids, and re-check group_id after any by-uuid fetch. Recommended mapping group_id = 'ws-<workspace uuid>'. Database-per-tenant needs Neo4j Enterprise (decision deferred to production: record in ADR-015).
